steps.title: Keep the route to help clear
steps.body: Explore how an employee requests a letter or leave and who follows up. Include local access conditions in testing, then use manager check-ins to discuss the first-month experience.

capabilities.name: Requisition approvals
capabilities.body: Explore a clear route from an operational staffing need to the person responsible for its approval.

capabilities.name: Panel participation
capabilities.body: Bring technical, business and location perspectives into structured candidate assessment.

capabilities.name: Onboarding ownership
capabilities.body: Make the people-related first steps and their responsible teams explicit across offices and sites.

capabilities.name: Employee requests
capabilities.body: Evaluate leave, letters and support journeys as a clearer connection between employees and HR.

ai.title: Draft the people plan. Leave safety to experts.
ai.body: Explore Brew's illustrative drafting approach for a non-safety onboarding conversation. A manager must review the result; do not use AI-generated text as operational instruction, certification or clearance.
ai.example: Draft first-month check-in questions for an office-based operations coordinator, focused on introductions and employee support.

pilot.title: Start with one location and sample records.
pilot.body: Bring central HR and a local manager into the same evaluation. Test the employee experience on realistic devices and connections.
checks: Role approvals include the appropriate operational owner.
People tasks and specialist clearance responsibilities stay distinct.
An employee can identify where a routine request should go.
pilot.boundary: Hirebrew does not replace safety management, permit-to-work, credential verification, medical fitness, rotation scheduling or sector compliance systems.

faqs.q: Does an onboarding checklist authorise site access?
faqs.a: No. Site access, competence and safety clearance must remain subject to your specialist systems, responsible personnel and approved procedures.

faqs.q: Will it work at locations with limited connectivity?
faqs.a: That needs testing with your actual devices and connections. The preview does not demonstrate offline access or guaranteed service availability.

faqs.q: Can it manage rotations or contractor compliance?
faqs.a: Those capabilities are not demonstrated. Scope employment models, rotations and contractor controls separately before deciding how any people-data handoff should work.
